description: Nonverbal vocal-event vocabulary. English event ids plus Indic native-script transcripts as first-class Event.value (direct orthography, not Latin-only).

annotation_policy.indic: For Indic speech, set Event.value to the native-script form (annotation_value). Transliteration is reference-only.
annotation_policy.english: For English / non-Indic, use snake_case event ids from events[].id.

events.label: hmm
events.definition: Voiced hum used as filler or soft acknowledgement.

events.label: hm
events.definition: Short hummed acknowledgement or thinking cue.

events.label: laugh
events.definition: Audible laughter episode (non-speech or dominant over speech).

events.label: smile-voice
events.definition: Audible smile quality on speech or near-speech vocalization.

events.label: gasp
events.definition: Sudden sharp inhale from surprise or emotion.

events.label: surprise
events.definition: Surprise vocalization not covered by ah/oh/huh.

events.label: audible breath
events.definition: Breath noise without clear in/out labeling.

events.label: sigh
events.definition: Deep audible in- and/or out-breath with sigh quality (not generic breath).

events.label: breath before speech
events.definition: Audible breath immediately preceding speech onset.

events.label: thinking sound
events.definition: Non-lexical thinking cue (often hummed); function THINK.

events.label: hesitation
events.definition: Hesitation span or filled pause behavior (prefer uh/um when clear).

events.label: self-correction
events.definition: Audible restart or repair vocalization around a correction.

events.label: unfinished utterance
events.definition: Abandoned / truncated utterance cue (trail-off or cut).

events.label: backchannel
events.definition: Short listener vocalization during other-speaker speech (DualTurn-style BC).

events.label: interruption vocalization
events.definition: Vocalization associated with interrupting or attempt to take floor.

events.label: tsk
events.definition: Dental click of disapproval or attention (tsk).

events.label: snicker
events.definition: Stifled laugh; often mockery or suppressed amusement.

events.label: lol-voice
events.definition: Playful laugh-like vocalization without full laugh episode.

events.label: surprised gasp
events.definition: Quick inhale of astonishment (distinct from fearful gasp).

events.label: fearful gasp
events.definition: Sudden inhale showing shock or fear.

events.label: sharp inhale
events.definition: Quick breath of sudden realization (not full gasp).

events.label: thinking filled pause
events.definition: Filled pause clearly marking word search / planning.

events.label: eh?
events.definition: Rising eh seeking confirmation or clarification.

events.label: hm?
events.definition: Rising hm / hmm as question or soft challenge.

events.label: questioning rise
events.definition: Ambiguous form with clear questioning rise.

references.title: DualTurn: Learning Turn-Taking from Dual-Channel Generative Speech Pretraining
references.note: Defines BC as short agent vocalization during user speech; informs interaction/backchannel.

references.title: Comparing Non-Verbal Vocalisations in Conversational Speech Corpora
references.note: Laughter and breath dominate NVVs; fillers and feedback treated as semi-words.

references.title: Comparing Annotations of Non-verbal Vocalisations in Speech Corpora
references.note: Cross-corpus category mismatch; laugh vs speech-laugh; breath subtyping limits.

references.title: An annotation scheme for sighs in spontaneous dialogue
references.note: Sigh distinct from generic breath: deep audible in-/out-breath.

references.title: Discrimination of linguistic and non-linguistic vocalizations in spontaneous speech
references.note: Separates consent/backchannel, filled pauses, vocal noise, laughter.

references.title: A Scalable Pipeline for Enabling Non-Verbal Speech Generation and Understanding (NonVerbalSpeech-38K)
references.note: Modern NV tags: laugh, sigh, cough, gasp, yawn, breath, sniff, throat clearing, cry.

references.title: NVSpeech: An Integrated and Scalable Pipeline for Human-Like Speech Modeling with Paralinguistic Vocalizations
references.note: Word-level paraverbal tags including Uhm, Confirmation-en, Laughter, Breathing, Sigh.

references.title: IndicVoices: Towards building an Inclusive Multilingual Speech Dataset for Indian Languages
references.note: Verbatim (Level-1) Indic transcription orthography; tags like [hmm] alongside native script.

references.title: Prosody Cues For Classification of the Discourse Particle hã in Hindi
references.note: Hindi हाँ / hã as ACK vs question vs backchannel by prosody.

references.title: Towards Disfluency Annotated Corpora for Indian Languages
references.note: Indic filled pauses vs meaningful interjections; Tamil ம்ம் etc.

references.title: LAION VocalBurst taxonomy (voice-taxonomies)
references.note: Laughter subtypes and gasp/inhale surprise variants.

references.title: Laughing, Breathing, Clicking - The Prosody of Nonverbal Vocalisations
references.note: Speech-laugh, affect bursts, fillers as NVVs.

references.title: Classification of Feedback Functions in Spoken Dialog Using LLMs and Prosodic Features
